lines.en: My wings buzz.
I fly low, skimming the grass tips.

lines.zh: 我一朵花接一朵花地看。
lines.en: I go from flower to flower.

lines.zh: 我停在叶子上，又飞起来。
lines.en: I perch on a leaf, then take off.
I fly over the water.
I dart left, then right.

lines.zh: 我的影子很小，在地上晃。
lines.en: My small shadow flickers on the ground.

lines.zh: 我慢慢落在一片大叶上。
lines.en: I settle on a big leaf.
I hover for a moment.
I glide with the wind.
I fly past your ear.
I land on a stone to tidy my wings.
I settle on a yellow flower.
I go around a spiderweb.
I crawl a way up a stalk.
I skim the ground past a shadow.
I rest on a flower.
My wings open and close slowly.
I am grooming my legs.
My shadow falls on the petals.
My compound eyes shift.
I spread my wings to the light.

lines.zh: 我擦干净口器上的花蜜。
lines.en: I wipe the nectar from my mouthparts.
I stay still; the wind rocks me.
I wait for the flower to open.
There is a dust of pollen on my wings.
I lift a foreleg to wipe my face.
I listen to a hum far off.
I fold my mouthparts in.
I rest on the underside of a leaf.

lines.zh: 你的影子罩住了这朵花。
lines.en: Your shadow covers this flower.
I take off and circle your face.
Your nose is very big.
I don't bite. I only drink nectar.
You have my shadow in your eyes.

lines.zh: 我停在你手指的关节上。
lines.en: I perch on your finger's joint.
Don't bring your palm down on me.
I fly near your hair.
Move once and I'm gone.
I hover in front of your eyebrows.
I fall into the grass.
One wing membrane has curled.
I crawl two steps on the ground.
I crawl back onto a leaf.
My wing's askew; I can't fly straight.
Cracks run across my compound eyes.
Crooked wings still buzz.
I spread my wings again.
I rest on a stone.
I rest a moment.
Is that nectar on your hand?
This thing on your hand is sweet.
I land on your finger.
I'll keep still; raise it slowly.
This flower is the kind I want.
That nectar smell is thick in my nose.
Do you have other flowers?
This flower is a little dry.
I take two sips and hover.
Don't blow at me.
Your fingertip brushed my wing membrane.
I shoot up at once.
I am too light to bump you.
Your finger brushed me aside.
Your sleeve drags me off course.

lines.zh: 你踩到我停的那朵花了。
lines.en: You stepped on the flower I was on.
I settle on your shoulder.
Your breath blows me off course.
I perch on your hat.
I fly off half a foot.
My kind lives only days.
My colours would be seen.
Staying on the flower is enough.
Don't close your hand on me.

lines.zh: 我跟着另一只的嗡嗡声。
lines.en: I follow another one's buzzing.
My wings are already worn.
I settle back on that flower.
This is my place.
I slowly fly away.
The wind is up again.
I drop down and clasp it with my legs.
Too heavy; I can't lift it.
I try to fly with it.
It fell into the flower's heart.
I kick it away with six legs.
This isn't nectar.
I carry it a short way.
I dropped it.
I hide it in the leaves.

lines.zh: 我要的是花蜜，不是这个。
lines.en: I want nectar, not this.

lines.zh: 你踩塌了我停的那朵花。
lines.en: You crushed the flower I sat on.
I take off and circle you.
There's something sweet at your cuff.
Your palm comes; I lift off first.
I land behind you.

lines.zh: 我在你后颈上停了一下。
lines.en: I light once on the back of your neck.
My buzzing never stops.
Don't wave; it knocks me aside.
I am right by your ear.
You've backed into the grass.
I skim the grass tips toward you.

lines.zh: 我的嗡嗡声到了你耳边。
lines.en: My buzz is at your ear.
I circle you, round and round.
I crawl along your collar.
You raise a hand; I fly off.
I settle on your back again.
My buzzing fades and returns.
You hear it, but can't see me.
I circle your hat.
The more you rush, the faster I go.
I am under your hat brim.
I fly a little closer.
I flattened my wings.

lines.zh: 你的手指从我上方掠过。
lines.en: Your fingers sweep over me.
I hold still by your ear.
I kick your face with my legs.
I bump into your eye.
It's light, but annoying.
My mouthparts jab once.
You swat air; I'm already gone.
I brush the corner of your eye with a wing.
My buzz turns shrill.
I duck into your collar and circle.
You swat again.
I've flown up out of reach.
I circle your fingers.

lines.zh: 我落在你脖子上叮了一口。
lines.en: I land on your neck and bite.
I crawl out of the flower.
My wings haven't hardened in the sun.
The sun is just right on my wings.
I shake the pollen off my wings.
There are plenty of flowers here.

lines.zh: 我第一次听见自己的嗡声。
lines.en: I hear my own buzzing for the first time.
My feet haven't quite gripped the leaf.

lines.zh: 这朵花上面的空气很暖。
lines.en: The air above this flower is warm.
I hear other buzzing.

lines.zh: 我的翅膜在阳光里晾开。
lines.en: My wing membranes dry in the sun.
I test my height.

lines.zh: 我的六条腿离开了叶子。
lines.en: All six of my legs leave the leaf.
I climb out from a grass stalk.
There is a newly opened flower here.

lines.zh: 火一来，我的翅膀就卷了。
lines.en: Fire comes and my wings curl.

lines.zh: 我摔在叶子上，翻了半圈。
lines.en: I hit a leaf and roll half over.

lines.zh: 水面把我粘住了，我挣不出来。
lines.en: The surface traps me and I can't pull free.
The blast flattens me into the grass.
A hole is torn in my wing membrane.
Spell-light blinds me.
The flowers have closed; nothing to eat.
The thunder knocks me down.
No wind, and I keep falling.
